how_to_use: Step 1: Open the Lumpsum Calculator on this page. Step 2: Enter your Investment Amount (₹) (e.g., ₹100,000). Step 3: Enter your Expected Annual Return (%) (e.g., ₹12). Step 4: Enter your Investment Duration (Years) (e.g., ₹10). Step 5: Click 'Calculate' to see instant results. Step 6: Review the detailed breakdown and use results for financial planning. Step 7: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
formula_explanation: The Lumpsum Calculator uses the following mathematical formula: FV = P × (1 + r/100)^n  where P = principal, r = annual return %, n = years. Each variable is derived from inputs you provide. The result reflects your specific financial scenario with Indian regulatory parameters built in.
example_calculation: Example: Invest ₹5,000/month for 10 years at 12% p.a. → Maturity ≈ ₹11.6 lakh; Invested ₹6 lakh; Returns ≈ ₹5.6 lakh.
